mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia potentiate propranolol's negative inotropic effects and increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias; propranolol may mask tachycardia from volume depletion.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly, assess heart rate and blood pressure closely, and consider potassium-sparing agent or supplementation to maintain normal electrolyte levels.
